# A.M. Best - Insurance Rating and Analytics

> A.M. Best provides comprehensive insurance credit ratings, capital adequacy analysis, and rating methodology for the life/health and property/casualty insurance industries.

A.M. Best is a leading credit rating agency specializing in the insurance sector. The site offers rating methodologies, capital adequacy tools (BCAR), and educational webinars for insurance professionals seeking to understand credit ratings and financial strength assessments.

## Key Topics

- A.M. Best
- Best's Credit Rating Methodology
- Best's Capital Adequacy Ratio (BCAR)
- Life/Health Insurance
- Insurance Rating
- Financial Strength Rating (FSR)
- Insurer Credit Rating (ICR)
- Capital Models
- Insurance Analytics
- Webinar Registration
- Rating Criteria
- Credit Rating Standards
- Insurance Financial Analysis
- Capital Adequacy Review
- Insurance Industry Standards

## Rating Methodology & Standards

- [Best's Credit Rating Methodology](https://www3.ambest.com/ambv/ratingmethodology): A.M. Best credit rating methodology, FSR, and ICR rating criteria and standards for insurance companies

## Educational Events & Webinars

- [Review of the Life/Health Best's Capital Adequacy Ratio](http://www3.ambest.com/conferences/events/eventregister.aspx?event_id=WEB479): Webinar registration for Life/Health BCAR review and insurance rating methodology
